notes: Adds editable, validated Agent Adapter YAML with built-in client definitions, three-version history, external-change detection, and immediate resource synchronization.
Adds user-level Terminal.app or iTerm launcher preferences for resuming Claude Code, Gemini CLI, and Kiro conversations.
Protects pinned and archived clipboard records from retention limits, keeps protected history visible beyond the ordinary cap, and expands defaults to 5,000 items and 120 days.
Keeps Clipboard search text consistent across remounts and expands remembered Recent Agent details to 500 items.
Prevents duplicate completion alerts without suppressing distinct fallback-only tasks or notifications from interleaved Agents.
Isolates macOS Debug builds as DingDong DEV with separate identity and data while improving community-install permission guidance.
